prerequisites: Successful completion of the basic and orientation examination modules
Achieved at least 120 ECTS credit points

learning_outcomes.text: Students should demonstrate their ability to independently apply the knowledge and skills acquired during their studies to complex tasks.
Subject-specific and methodological competencies, as well as social and personal competencies, are emphasized differently depending on the chosen course.

syllabus_topics: Students can freely choose a topic from a given catalog of subjects provided by the respective professor or propose a topic from practice with a company.
Contents are subject-related to the study program.
The catalog of subjects is announced by the respective professor.
This allows for individual focus and specialization.

assessment_methods.method: Bachelor's thesis (project work, scientifically documented with approx. 60 pages)
